scope: 25 common documented Output native routes; version-sensitive/transport-gated contracts excluded

contracts.parameters: int memberId
contracts.summary: Reads the complete single-block steel-design result packet for one analytical member.
contracts.remarks: Prefer this query when code, decision, governing case/station/clause/section, allowable ratio, FX/MY/MZ and slenderness are needed. GetMemberSteelUtilizationRatio returns only a ratio. PASS/FAIL text is classified explicitly; numeric, Boolean or other status variants are preserved as Unknown rather than guessed. The three unreturned FY/FZ/MX actions are unavailable and are never set to zero. Governing case IDs are not hydrated or activated. Native false takes precedence over any written outputs.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.summary: Counts the native eigen-buckling factors already extracted.
contracts.remarks: This returns an actual integral count, not a success flag or a factor value. Zero is a valid count and does not prove that another result family is unavailable. GetBucklingResultAvailability observes availability; GetBucklingModeDisplacements retrieves one shape. No eigenanalysis is started.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.parameters: int nativeBucklingModeNumber, int nodeId
contracts.summary: Reads all six native eigen-buckling mode-shape components at one node.
contracts.remarks: Use for a buckling mode shape, not static displacement or a scalar buckling factor. The native mode number/index is passed unchanged; no zero/one-based conversion or count-derived remapping occurs. Six initialized Double slots are passed by reference and must be written on native 1/true success. Mode-shape normalization is not converted into physical static length/rotation units. Native numeric -1 is not accepted as this operation’s documented 1/0 flag.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.parameters: int memberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId
contracts.summary: Reads the relative native X/Y/Z member translation at a specified station.
contracts.remarks: Use for the native relative translations described in local X/Y/Z order. GetAbsoluteMemberDisplacement invokes a different native operation whose prose is ambiguous; neither query applies a managed frame or offset transformation. This returns three translations, not six nodal translation/rotation values.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<Vector3D> GetRelativeMemberDisplacement(int memberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId)

contracts.parameters: int memberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId
contracts.summary: Reads the absolute-labelled native X/Y/Z member translation at a specified station.
contracts.remarks: Calls the native AbsTrans operation, separately from GetRelativeMemberDisplacement. The installed name says absolute while its prose repeats relative; the result preserves native X/Y/Z slots and does not certify an absolute/relative transformation. No offset transfer, basis reconstruction, rotation, length-fraction conversion or zero substitution is applied.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<Vector3D> GetAbsoluteMemberDisplacement(int memberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId)

contracts.parameters: int physicalMemberId, MemberEnd memberEnd, int loadCaseId, ResultCoordinateSystem coordinateSystem = ResultCoordinateSystem.Local
contracts.summary: Reads six physical-member end actions in explicitly selected native local/global axes.
contracts.remarks: Use for physical-member IDs and native physical start/end incidence. GetMemberEndForces takes analytical member IDs. MemberEnd.Start/End map to native 0/1; ResultCoordinateSystem.Local/Global map independently to 0/1 and do not reuse the oppositely numbered offset enum. Physical incidence reordering may change signs; no managed reordering, rotation or sign correction is applied. FX/FY/FZ retain force units and MX/MY/MZ force-times-length units.
contracts.example:
var result = output.GetPhysicalMemberEndForces(7, MemberEnd.Start, 1, ResultCoordinateSystem.Local);
if (result.IsSuccessful) System.Console.WriteLine(result.Data.Fx);
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<ForceComponents> GetPhysicalMemberEndForces(int physicalMemberId, MemberEnd memberEnd, int loadCaseId, ResultCoordinateSystem coordinateSystem = ResultCoordinateSystem.Local)

contracts.parameters: int memberId, int loadCaseId
contracts.summary: Reads signed axial-force minimum/maximum values and both native stations.
contracts.remarks: Unlike GetMemberForcesAtDistance, this requests native extrema over the member. Values are not absolute extrema, sorted envelopes across load cases or recalculated forces. Minimum must not exceed maximum; both written stations must be nonnegative. Positions retain native length units from the analytical start.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.parameters: int memberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId
contracts.summary: Reads six local section actions at a specified analytical member station.
contracts.remarks: This returns FX/FY/FZ/MX/MY/MZ at a native distance from the analytical start. GetPhysicalMemberForcesAtDistance uses physical-member identity and total physical length. It is not an end-action sign conversion, result envelope or normalized eigenmode. Station zero is allowed; member membership and upper station validity remain native decisions. No implicit length-fraction conversion, unit scaling or geometry hydration occurs.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<ForceComponents> GetMemberForcesAtDistance(int memberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId)

contracts.parameters: int physicalMemberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId
contracts.summary: Reads six local section actions at a specified physical member station.
contracts.remarks: This returns FX/FY/FZ/MX/MY/MZ at a native distance from the physical start. GetMemberForcesAtDistance uses analytical member identity; IDs are not interchangeable. It is not an end-action sign conversion, result envelope or normalized eigenmode. Station zero is allowed; member membership and upper station validity remain native decisions. No implicit length-fraction conversion, unit scaling or geometry hydration occurs.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<ForceComponents> GetPhysicalMemberForcesAtDistance(int physicalMemberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId)

contracts.parameters: int memberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId
contracts.summary: Reads the two native Y/Z deflection outputs at one analytical member station.
contracts.remarks: Choose this for the two-output native deflection operation; GetRelativeMemberDisplacement and GetAbsoluteMemberDisplacement return three translation slots through different functions. The help does not fully establish the Y/Z frame or absolute/relative convention, so NativeY/NativeZ preserve slot identity without asserting a transformation. No missing X value or rotations are invented.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<MemberDeflection> GetMemberDeflectionAtDistance(int memberId, double distanceFromStart, int loadCaseId)

contracts.parameters: IEnumerable<int> supportNodeIds, int maximumResults = 100000
contracts.summary: Reads native ELASTIC MAT influence areas corresponding to an explicit support-node selection.
contracts.remarks: Use for YZ/ZX/XY influence areas, not base pressures or Load floor influence areas. Input is snapshotted once with a bounded selection; order and duplicates are retained. Empty input returns an owned empty result without native result calls. Exported metadata passes initialized arrays by value, so every applicable Double slot must be written in place. Native integer 0 means success; -107/-108 mean buffer failure. Actual Boolean acknowledgements are interpreted separately, never converted to an integer zero. Changed node correspondence rejects mixed data. Areas retain native length-squared units.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.parameters: int loadCaseId, IEnumerable<int> supportNodeIds, int maximumResults = 100000
contracts.summary: Reads signed base pressures for explicitly ordered support nodes and one result case.
contracts.remarks: Requires native BASE PRESSURE results; it does not calculate contact pressure from support reactions or ELASTIC MAT influence areas. Native YZ/ZX/XY arrays correspond to global X/Y/Z pressure components in force-per-area units. The Boolean-success contract differs from GetMatInfluenceAreas integer-zero success. Bounded one-pass input snapshots preserve duplicates/order, validate written fixed-size arrays and reject changed node correspondence. Empty input returns an owned empty result without native retrieval.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<IReadOnlyList<NodeBasePressure>> GetBasePressures(int loadCaseId, IEnumerable<int> supportNodeIds, int maximumResults = 100000)

contracts.parameters: int solidId, int nativeCornerIndex, int loadCaseId
contracts.summary: Reads SXX/SYY/SZZ normal stresses at an explicitly identified native solid corner.
contracts.remarks: Use for solid elements, not plate-center stresses. The nonnegative native corner selector is passed unchanged; it is not an analytical node ID and no zero/one-based corner mapping or center sentinel is invented. Named component ordering follows the native output slots; no principal transformation is performed. All three native stress values must be written and finite on success. Native result stress units and signs are preserved.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<SolidNormalStresses> GetSolidNormalStresses(int solidId, int nativeCornerIndex, int loadCaseId)

contracts.summary: Reads SXY/SYZ/SZX shear stresses at an explicitly identified native solid corner.
contracts.remarks: Use for solid elements, not plate-center stresses. The nonnegative native corner selector is passed unchanged; it is not an analytical node ID and no zero/one-based corner mapping or center sentinel is invented. Named component ordering follows the native output slots; no principal transformation is performed. All three native stress values must be written and finite on success. Native result stress units and signs are preserved.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<SolidShearStresses> GetSolidShearStresses(int solidId, int nativeCornerIndex, int loadCaseId)

contracts.parameters: int solidId, int nativeCornerIndex, int loadCaseId
contracts.summary: Reads three native principal-stress slots at an explicitly identified native solid corner.
contracts.remarks: Use for solid elements, not plate-center stresses. The nonnegative native corner selector is passed unchanged; it is not an analytical node ID and no zero/one-based corner mapping or center sentinel is invented. The help repeats S1 labels, so FirstNativeValue/SecondNativeValue/ThirdNativeValue retain native slot order without sorting or claiming descending S1/S2/S3. All three native stress values must be written and finite on success. Native result stress units and signs are preserved.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<SolidPrincipalStresses> GetSolidPrincipalStresses(int solidId, int nativeCornerIndex, int loadCaseId)

contracts.parameters: int loadCaseId
contracts.summary: Reads the native nonlinear load-step value for one result load case.
contracts.remarks: The return is numeric data, not a Boolean flag or a certified step count/index range. Nonnegative finite values are preserved without rounding. Native -1 is NativeFailure, -8002 NotFound and -9911 ResultsUnavailable. No arbitrary nonzero success rule is used. This does not retrieve nonlinear node displacements or activate a load step.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.summary: Counts the native steel-design parameter blocks in the applicable result context.
contracts.remarks: The reviewed help limits multiple-block extraction to AISC 360-16. GetMultipleSteelDesignResultAvailability observes that capability separately. Zero is a valid count; it is not a fabricated successful design result or a Boolean false. No block names, governing blocks, design changes or results freshness are inferred.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.summary: Counts modes already extracted by native dynamic analysis.
contracts.remarks: This is an integral mode count, not buckling-factor count or a success flag. Zero remains valid data. It does not establish mode numbering, result normalization or whether the modal set is current. No dynamic analysis is started.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.parameters: int nativeModeNumber
contracts.summary: Reads the native frequency in Hz for an explicitly identified dynamic mode.
contracts.remarks: Use for modal frequency, not a buckling eigenvalue or time-history interval. The nonnegative native mode number/index is passed unchanged and is not rebased from a managed index. Zero frequency is retained when native success reports it; negative or unwritten/nonfinite frequency is rejected. No cycles/radians conversion occurs.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.parameters: int nativeModeNumber, int nodeId
contracts.summary: Reads six dynamic eigenmode shape components at an analytical node.
contracts.remarks: Use for a dynamic modal shape; GetBucklingModeDisplacements queries a different mode family and GetNodeDisplacements retrieves load-case responses. The native mode number/index is passed unchanged. Exported metadata takes the six-element initialized array by value, so all applicable slots must be written in place. Native normalization is not rescaled into physical static displacement and no rotations are invented.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.parameters: int nativeModeNumber
contracts.summary: Reads native X/Y/Z mass participation factors for an explicit dynamic mode.
contracts.remarks: Use for one mode, not missing-mass factors, cumulative participation or a load-case force result. The native mode number/index is passed unchanged. All three scalar slots must be written and finite. Fraction-versus-percentage and eigenvector normalization are not inferred; no factors are rescaled or summed.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.summary: Reads native time-history response-sample count and integration interval.
contracts.remarks: Unlike a Boolean availability query, this returns a sample count plus an interval in seconds. Native 0 means ResultsUnavailable and -1 NativeFailure; a positive count requires a positive finite interval. The first response is at time zero and the last at (count-1)*interval; no extra endpoint is invented. It does not run integration or certify result freshness.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.

contracts.parameters: int nodeId, ResponseDegreeOfFreedom degreeOfFreedom, TimeHistoryResponseKind responseKind, double timeSeconds
contracts.summary: Reads a native time-history response at one bounded time.
contracts.remarks: GetTimeHistoryResponse retrieves the full integration series. The reserved native load-case argument is always internal zero; no caller case is activated. The native response DOF/kind selects translational or rotational displacement/velocity/acceleration units. Integration metadata is read before/after; requested time must lie in 0..(count-1)*interval. Native 1/true succeeds, 0/false means ResultsUnavailable and integer -1 means NativeFailure, never VARIANT_TRUE. Native interpolation, if any, is not reproduced in managed code. Changed integration metadata returns StateChanged with no sample.
contracts.example:
var result = output.GetTimeHistoryResponseAtTime(11, ResponseDegreeOfFreedom.TranslationX, TimeHistoryResponseKind.Displacement, 0.0);
if (result.IsSuccessful) System.Console.WriteLine(result.Data.Value);
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<TimeHistorySample> GetTimeHistoryResponseAtTime(int nodeId, ResponseDegreeOfFreedom degreeOfFreedom, TimeHistoryResponseKind responseKind, double timeSeconds)

contracts.parameters: int nodeId, ResponseDegreeOfFreedom degreeOfFreedom, TimeHistoryResponseKind responseKind, int maximumSamples = 100000
contracts.summary: Reads a bounded, owned native time-history response series.
contracts.remarks: Use for all integration samples rather than one requested time. The reserved native load-case argument stays internal zero. A checked integration count sizes the Double buffer; counts exceeding maximumSamples produce LimitExceeded before allocation or retrieval. Sample zero is at time zero; no extra final sample is added. Native 1/true succeeds, 0/false means ResultsUnavailable and integer -1 NativeFailure. Count/interval are rechecked after retrieval; StateChanged discards mixed data. Samples preserve signs and response-dependent native units; no smoothing, interpolation, differentiation or unit conversion occurs.
contracts.example:
var result = output.GetTimeHistoryResponse(11, ResponseDegreeOfFreedom.TranslationX, TimeHistoryResponseKind.Displacement);
if (result.IsSuccessful) System.Console.WriteLine(result.Data.Samples.Count);
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<TimeHistorySeries> GetTimeHistoryResponse(int nodeId, ResponseDegreeOfFreedom degreeOfFreedom, TimeHistoryResponseKind responseKind, int maximumSamples = 100000)

contracts.summary: Observes native availability for multiple steel-design parameter-block extraction.
contracts.remarks: This is distinct from general analysis or buckling availability. The reviewed contract identifies AISC 360-16 as the applicable design context. A successful observation with Data=false is valid data, not a query failure. Native Boolean or integral 0/1 is accepted; an integral -1 is not borrowed as success. No design code is changed and no multiple-block result packet is inferred.
contracts.returns: A named status/data result. Inspect IsSuccessful before Data; native failure, unavailable results, changed state or managed limits expose no payload. Actual Boolean and integral return evidence remain distinct.
